Independent_Variable: Cargo_Volume = Total freight transported through inland waterways (measured in billion tons)
Container_Throughput = Container shipping capacity (measured in million TEUs - Twenty-foot Equivalent Units)
YoY_Growth_Rate = Year-over-Year percentage change in cargo or container volume
Investment_Level = Capital expenditure on waterway infrastructure projects (measured in billion yuan)
Time_Period = Specific months or years during which data was collected
